# आखिरी चिट्ठी — the owner's storyboard, beat by beat

The owner's reference frames for this film (sent again on 17 October 2026 at 1920x1280) are the same pictures already
in `../stills/` (1600x1066, bundled in the APK under `film_library/aakhiri_chitthi/stills/`); they are not stored a
second time. These are the look to reach, not pictures to cast: the director takes the characters, the props and the
place from the cut-out pictures in `../plan.txt`. Scene and beat refer to `../aakhiri_chitthi_numbered.txt`.

| Still | Scene | Beat |
|---|---|---|
| storyboard_upload_36.jpg, storyboard_upload_50.jpg | 1 | रघुवीर जी alone on the broken bench (brick under its leg), both hands on the stick, staring at the padlocked postbox; tea cart behind |
| storyboard_upload_37.jpg | 2 | परी runs in along the dirt road, bag bouncing, ribbons flying, sweat, one sandal |
| storyboard_upload_35.jpg, storyboard_upload_47.jpg | 2 | परी reaches for the postbox; रघुवीर जी startled and cross ("अरे, कौन है?") |
| storyboard_upload_41.jpg | 2 | रघुवीर जी looks up at the sky with tears; परी looks up at him (her blazer is not her costume: off-model) |
| storyboard_upload_42.jpg | 2 | परी kneels by the bag and takes the letter out from among the dry leaves |
| storyboard_upload_44.jpg, storyboard_upload_48.jpg | 3 | the letter changes hands ("बापू के लिए" on it); her bag lies on the ground; his glasses on |
| storyboard_upload_45.jpg | 3 | the same handover, but परी with brown hair and dungarees: off-model, never her look |
| storyboard_upload_39.jpg, storyboard_upload_43.jpg | 3 | both on one bench: the letter pressed to his chest in both hands, tears; her hand on his, eyes closed, smiling |
| storyboard_upload_40.jpg | 3 | he wipes his eyes with his sleeve; she sits beside him, eyes closed, at peace |
| storyboard_upload_38.jpg, neem_upload_31.jpg | 1–3 | neem leaves against the sun; leaves blowing in the warm wind |
| neem_upload_30.jpg, neem_upload_33.jpg, neem_upload_34.jpg | 1–3 | the neem's shade and dappled ground; the clear sky; the open field |

What every frame agrees on (the checks the film is held to): one bench, propped on a brick, shared by both of them in
scene 3; the red rusty postbox with its small padlock; the tea cart with the kettle and upturned glasses; dry neem leaves
on bare earth; परी with black hair in two bunches with red ribbons, blue uniform, pink torn bag; रघुवीर जी bald with white
fringe and moustache, khaki kurta-pyjama with holes, barefoot, the stick in his hand.
